name: Paper
tagline: A warm, roomy reading look for agent chats: serif replies on paper, soft rounded prompts.
description: A whole cmux look built only from public surfaces: a theme file for color, settings for type and spacing, a stylesheet of cmux.agentPane.style/1 tokens for the prompt bubble and cards, and a customize view for the sidebar's hover card and rows. Remove it and everything you had comes back.
